# Repository Instructions

- This is a Re:VIEW book template. Manuscripts live in `articles/chapters/`, chapter order in `articles/catalog.yml`, book and layout settings in `articles/config.yml`.
- Read `README.md` before changing build, config, or layout files.

## Verification

- After any code change: `bun run lint`, `bun run format`.
- After any Actions change: `jactionlint`, `ghalint run`, `ghalint run-action`, `zizmor .`.
